review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that nowadays people's lives are heavily influenced by the news media and this is an adverse improvement. From my perspective, although it is not a positive development, this is not fully bad.

Admittedly, news media have too much influence on society these days. This can be seen clearly in the widespread access to smartphones and the Internet, which allow people to follow the news instantly regardless of wherever and whenever they are. It naturally follows that news has become a regular part of their routine. Another reason is the intense competition among news outlets. In order to gain attention, most media agencies focus on shocking and breaking content and present it in a highly sensationalized manner with dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals, reinforcing the overall impact of news on public opinion.

Though this situation does not have only the negative effects. It is irrefutably true that the exposure to a constant stream of distressing and exaggerated news will overwhelm people. This can also be possible to make them feel overly anxious and helpless even in situations that do not directly affect them. However, the news coverage these days also warn the public to existing and looming problems in society, say, crime, natural disasters, or political corruption. This helps individuals to be better informed and more prepared to respond to potential threats, making them be possible to handle risks in an increasingly complex society.
In conclusion, I strongly believe that although people are surrounding with news media today, it does not contain bad effects.

completion.comment: Bài có đủ mở bài, hai đoạn thân và kết bài.

review.overall: Em đã viết đủ bốn phần, giải thích rõ hai cơ chế ảnh hưởng lớn và triển khai cả quá tải tinh thần lẫn ích lợi cảnh báo. Phần Body 1 nhìn chung dùng được; Cô giữ các câu đúng của em. Việc cần sửa tập trung ở lập trường mở–kết, câu rời bắt đầu bằng Though và hai cấu trúc dùng possible sai với người/tác nhân. Kết bài hiện phủ nhận tác hại dù chính Body 2 đã thừa nhận tác hại ấy.

paragraphs: There is an opinion that nowadays people's lives are heavily influenced by the news media and this is an adverse development. From my perspective, although the news media have a major influence on people, their effects are not entirely negative.

Admittedly, the news media exert a substantial influence on society today. This can be seen clearly in the widespread access to smartphones and the Internet, which allow people to follow the news instantly wherever and whenever they are. It naturally follows that news has become a regular part of their routine. Another reason is the intense competition among news outlets. In order to gain attention, most media agencies focus on shocking and breaking content and present it in a highly sensationalized manner with dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals, reinforcing the overall impact of news on public opinion.

This situation, however, does not have only negative effects. It is irrefutably true that the exposure to a constant stream of distressing and exaggerated news can overwhelm people. This can also make them feel overly anxious and helpless even in situations that do not directly affect them. However, the news coverage these days also warns the public to existing and looming problems in society, say, crime, natural disasters, or political corruption. This helps individuals to be better informed and more prepared to respond to potential threats, making them able to handle risks in an increasingly complex society.

In conclusion, I strongly believe that although people are surrounded by news media today and can experience anxiety, this major influence is not entirely negative, as news coverage also alerts them to risks.
